title: DRV8833 2 Channel DC Motor Driver
description_text:
DRV8833 2 Channel DC Motor Driver 
 The DRV8833 2 Channel DC Motor Driver is a small, powerful motor driver that controls two brushed DC motors. It works with motor voltages between 2.7V and 10.8V, providing up to 1.2A of continuous current per channel, with short bursts up to 2A. This makes it ideal for low-voltage, small-motor applications. The board comes fully assembled with the DRV8833 chip and includes a safety feature for reverse battery protection. It also has built-in current limits and doesn’t need an external power supply for the logic voltage, making it easy to use in various projects. 
 Key features 
 
 Dual-H-bridge for two DC motors or one stepper motor. 
 Voltage range: 2.7V to 10.8V. 
 1.2A continuous (2A peak) per motor, 2.4A continuous (4A peak) when paralleled. 
 3V- and 5V-compatible inputs. 
 Protection against under-voltage, over-current, and over-temperature. 
 Reverse-voltage protection. 
 Current limiting with optional sense resistors.

title: VL53L0X Laser Ranging Sensor
description_text:
VL53L0X Laser Ranging Sensor 
  The VL53L0X laser ranging  sensor  from ST Microelectronics is a time-of-flight ranging system integrated into a compact module.  This time-of-flight (TOF) measurement enables it to accurately determine the absolute distance to a target without the object's reflectance greatly influencing the measurement. 
 Applications: 
 
  Obstacle detection in robotics.  
  Hand detection in hand driers, soap dispensers, faucets, etc.  
  Gesture recognition in one dimension.  
  Widely used in-camera autofocus to enhance the camera performance in low light or fast-moving objects conditions.  
  Used as a proximity sensor in many phones.

title: ELBOTICS 12.8V 6Ah LiFePO4 Battery with Smart BMS – 76.8Wh Deep Cycle Lithium Battery for Solar, Inverter, Backup & DIY Projects (2 Year Warranty)
description_text:
ELBOTICS 12.8V 6Ah LiFePO4 Battery – 76.8Wh with Built-in Smart BMS  
 
 Power your compatible solar, backup and electronics projects with the  ELBOTICS 12.8V 6Ah Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) Battery . 
 Delivering  76.8Wh of nominal energy , this rechargeable deep-cycle battery combines LiFePO4 chemistry with an integrated  Battery Management System (BMS)  for dependable charging and discharging protection. 
 Designed for  2000+ charge-discharge cycles , it provides a lightweight alternative to conventional lead-acid batteries for compatible low-voltage power applications. 
 🔋 6Ah / 6000mAh Capacity 
 With a rated capacity of  6Ah (6000mAh) , the battery provides: 
  12.8V × 6Ah = 76.8Wh  
 This makes it suitable for compact power systems where rechargeable energy storage, low weight and repeated cycling are important. 
 ⚡ LiFePO4 Battery Technology 
 Unlike conventional lithium-ion chemistries, this battery uses  Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)  chemistry. 
 LiFePO4 technology is particularly well suited to applications requiring repeated charge and discharge cycles and stable battery performance. 
 Battery Specifications 
  Nominal Voltage:  12.8V  Capacity:  6Ah / 6000mAh  Nominal Energy:  76.8Wh  Chemistry:  LiFePO4  Rechargeable:  Yes  Cycle Life:  2000+ cycles  Approx. Weight:  600–605g 
 🛡️ Built-in Smart BMS Protection 
 The integrated Battery Management System helps protect the battery against common abnormal electrical conditions. 
 According to the supplied product specifications, BMS protection includes: 
 
 Over-charge protection 
 Over-discharge protection 
 Over-current protection 
 Short-circuit protection 
 
 The BMS helps manage battery operation, but the battery should still be used with appropriately rated equipment and a  LiFePO4-compatible charging system . 
 🔄 2000+ Cycle Deep-Cycle Design 
 The battery is designed to provide  2000+ charge-discharge cycles , making it suitable for applications that require frequent cycling. 
 The supplied specification indicates operation at approximately  70–80% Depth of Discharge (DOD)  for long-term use. 
 Actual cycle life will vary depending on charging voltage, discharge current, operating temperature, depth of discharge and storage conditions. 
 ☀️ Suitable for Solar & Backup Applications 
 The ELBOTICS 12.8V 6Ah battery can be used in appropriately specified systems including: 
  Solar energy projects   Small backup power systems   Compatible inverter applications   Energy storage projects   Robotics   Portable electronics   DIY electronics   Embedded systems and prototypes  
 Always verify the equipment's required voltage, current, connector/terminal arrangement and charging requirements before installation. 
 🪶 Lightweight Design 
 At approximately  600–605 grams , the battery offers substantial energy storage without the weight associated with many traditional lead-acid battery solutions. 
 This makes it particularly useful for portable projects, robotics and installations where reducing overall system weight is beneficial.
